note: Security Overhaul SKSE - Regional Locks v1.0.1. FOMOD required files are meshes/ and RegionalLocks_LID.ini; the only choice is the texture group, taken at 1k per TEXTURE_POLICY. Adds hold-specific locks (Solitude, Whiterun, Windhelm, Markarth, Riften, Raven Rock, Tel Mithryn, College of Winterhold) plus cage, safe and strongbox locks. Asset-only: no DLL, no plugin. Note the Markarth lock is only visible with Unique Markarth Doors, which is not installed here.
